name: Heartbreak
source:
Eni’s friend signed her up for a game club to finally get a boyfriend. There are some pretty guys in that club, but should you really force romance if you two aren’t a good fit for each other?

[from [url=https://kanity.itch.io/heartbreak]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了让埃妮终于能交到男朋友，朋友替她报名参加了游戏社。社团里确实有些帅哥，可如果两人并不合适，真的应该勉强谈恋爱吗？

[摘自[url=https://kanity.itch.io/heartbreak]itch.io[/url]]
